17: VASILÍSA PEREGRÍNOVNA. But how can I keep still, benefactress? Such lack of feeling! Such ingratitude! It pierces the heart. MADAM ULANBÉKOV. I command you to keep still, and you must keep still!
16: GRÍSHA. Well, I declare! I slave, and slave, and can't ever go anywhere! VASILÍSA PEREGRÍNOVNA. Oh me, oh my! Oh me, oh my! How spoiled you are! How spoiled you are!
15: GRÍSHA. No, but please let me, ma'am. MADAM ULANBÉKOV. You stay right here! Put that nonsense out of your head!
14: GRÍSHA. Please do, mistress. MADAM ULANBÉKOV. I tell you, positively, no! One's morals are just spoiled at these fairs. Your greedy ears will take in all kinds of nastiness! You're still a boy; that's no place for you!
13: GRÍSHA. [ Clasping his hands behind him ] Please, ma'am. MADAM ULANBÉKOV. No, most certainly not!
12: GRÍSHA. Let me go down-town; to-day's a holiday there. MADAM ULANBÉKOV. What do you want to go for? To stare at the drunkards?
11: GRÍSHA. [ Approaches, swaggering, and stops in a free and easy pose ] Mistress! MADAM ULANBÉKOV. What's the matter with you?
10: MADAM ULANBÉKOV. Such people fairly drive you into sin. [ Kissing him ] You have a beautiful soul, my dear! [ To VASILÍSA PEREGRÍNOVNA] Indeed, I have always thought that God himself sometimes speaks with the lips of babes. Líza! Go tell Nadezhda not to cry, that I have turned out NEGLIGÉNTOV. LÍZA. Yes, ma'am. [ She goes out .
8: MADAM ULANBÉKOV. Tell your uncle that I shall always be your benefactress; but don't you even think about a wife! Be gone, be gone! NEGLIGÉNTOV. I thank you for not deserting me! [ To GRÍSHA] Ask the mistress to let you go to the fair, and catch up with me! [ He goes out .
7: MADAM ULANBÉKOV. No, no, never! NEGLIGÉNTOV. [ On his knees ] Uncle told me to beg you with tears, because I am a lost man, subject to many vices, and, without your favor, I shall not be tolerated in the civil service.
6: MADAM ULANBÉKOV. Be gone, and don't you ever dare to show yourself to me! NEGLIGÉNTOV. Uncle says that I fell into loose living because of my bachelor life, and that I may get mired in it unless you show me your favor.
5: GRÍSHA. Why, he himself tells us all that he is a member in the court, not a copy-clerk. And so they call him the member. NEGLIGÉNTOV. I call myself the member, although falsely, but expressly for the respect of the court menials, and in order to escape scoffing and insult.
4: GRÍSHA. The member dances very comically. MADAM ULANBÉKOV. What do you mean, "member"?
3: GRÍSHA bursts out laughing. MADAM ULANBÉKOV. Stop, stop! [NEGLIGÉNTOV ceases . To GRÍSHA] What are you laughing at?
2: NEGLIGÉNTOV. [ Dances and sings ] "I shall go, shall go to mow Upon the meadow green."
1: MADAM ULANBÉKOV. What in the world! Good heavens! Go away, my dear sir, go away! LEONÍD. Oh, mamma, he's comical; wait a bit before driving him out. Dance, NEGLIGÉNTOV!
0: LEONÍD. What was your conduct like? NEGLIGÉNTOV. Reprehensible.
